# Carnival Corporation Connects with Travel Advisors at CruiseWorld 2026


Nov 13, 2026


Share


Carnival Corporation took center stage at CruiseWorld 2026 in Fort Lauderdale, connecting with travel advisors through candid conversations, destination insights and plenty of fun along the way.


Bettina A. Deynes, global chief human resources officer, sat down for a candid conversation about her career journey and the lessons that shaped her leadership. She also shared perspectives on authenticity, accountability and continuous learning that resonated with travel advisors and small business owners building businesses of their own.


Marie McKenzie, senior vice president of government and destination affairs, and Ally Nichols, vice president of integrated planning and product development, also took the stage for a fireside chat. Together they further familiarized travel advisors with the company’s growing portfolio of destinations and how Carnival Corporation works with the communities its ships visit to create memorable experiences for guests and shared value for local residents.


The connections continued offstage at the Carnival Corporation Travel Agent Lounge, where advisors could meet with sales teams from six of our world-class cruise lines, refresh their professional headshots and snap social-ready photos. The company’s cruise lines were also represented on the trade show floor, giving advisors even more opportunities to connect, discover what’s new and enter for a chance to win one of six cruise giveaways.
